reason: This is not just a routine dependency bump: the metadata shows accompanying code changes in core executor and KV/store paths (`adapter.go`, `mem_reader.go`, `union_scan.go`, `pkg/kv/{error,key}.go`, `pkg/store/driver/error/error.go`) plus session txn and integration regression tests. A client-go upgrade that requires touching key/error translation and executor read paths can affect transaction/runtime correctness, visibility, and storage error semantics across broad surfaces. That combination is central and risky enough to justify a focused 20-40 minute deep review for Blocker/High issues.
